unique_value: authorization is bound to immutable evidence content hashes and monotonic evidence versions rather than mutable evidence identifiers alone
single- and multi-evidence decisions fail closed when evidence disappears changes content or advances version after binding
versioned immutable snapshot history turns evidence drift into an explicit authorization failure instead of a hidden TOCTOU condition
authorization outcomes are retained in a repository-local audit trail with deterministic evidence fingerprints
source identity and evidence identity are signed and freshness-bounded before evidence can join authorization quorum
source quorum counts distinct identities and required roles rather than repeated attestations
evidence bytes are externalized to content-addressed storage and exact bytes are re-read by digest before authorization

lineage_distinction.GlacierEQ/lockheed-dual-key-actuator-fen: owns dual-control side-effect authority and short-lived actuator grants; complementary actuation boundary, not evidence snapshot provenance
lineage_distinction.GlacierEQ/lockheed-mission-thread-isolat: owns cross-thread mutable-authority isolation and explicit exports; complementary isolation boundary, not evidence binding

extractable_mechanisms: post-bind CAS tamper and missing-object refusal
capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning Lockheed-specialist implementation of evidence-bound action authorization; capability extraction preserves repository identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Replace reference HMAC identity with remotely verifiable PKI/KMS-backed source identity and live key revocation freshness, add provider-attested replicated object storage, and reconcile source quorum across gateway instances without weakening exact evidence/version/content/freshness binding.
nonclaims: no Lockheed Martin internal architecture claim
repository relationships do not imply exercised integration
HMAC source credentials are reference identity rather than production PKI or KMS identity
directory CAS proves filesystem externalization and digest readback rather than cloud replication or provider-managed durability
source-key revocation is not yet a live post-issuance feed
source quorum is local rather than distributed or consensus reconciled
